orgName: The Emirates FA Cup and Adobe Women's FA Cup

source.name: Sportcal, 'Carling extends FA Cup sponsorship to 2027'

note: Official beer partner of the men's and women's FA Cups until 2027. Sportcal (fetched): Carling initially struck a three-year deal with the FA in 2023, replacing Budweiser; the October 2025 renewal adds two seasons. The FA's official FA Cup page footer lists Carling among the competition's sponsors (thefa.com/competitions/thefacup, fetched).
